fields.System.Title: TRF-2 — Origin side
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Get the stock picked, packed, and out of the origin warehouse — reusing the outbound machinery
rather than duplicating it.

Scope

In. Allocation and picking for a transfer, packing, dispatch to in-transit.

Out. Everything at the destination — that is [TRF-3](TRF-3-destination-side.md).

Design notes

Reuse outbound, do not reimplement it. A transfer's origin side is an order with a
warehouse instead of a customer. Picking, packing, and the scan discipline are identical. This
is why the epic sits at Stage 5 — those flows must be solid first.

TRF-203 is the critical story. Dispatch moves stock from the origin location to
VIRT-INTRANSIT, not to nowhere and not to the destination. The stock still exists; it is just
available at neither site.

Getting this wrong in either direction is bad: destroying it at dispatch means the destination
receipt creates stock from nothing, and crediting the destination early means both sites can
promise it.

Record what was dispatched, line by line. The destination receipt is validated against this,
and it is the only evidence available when the two disagree.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| In-transit stock counted as available | [doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Dispatch confirmed before loading finishes | [doc 05 WF 8](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Dispatch record incomplete, so receipt cannot be validated | [doc 09 §9.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
